answer: A lotus-pond attestation at a tidal inlet admits a newcomer only when one lotus blooms in a marked bed: at low tide two keepers lower a mirror disk into the pond and log the depth where it vanishes. A bed with no bloom, or water too murky for the disk to reach two metres, voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond. Each bed costs a $140 lease plus a $60 keeper fee, so 100 fakes need 100 beds, $20,000 in fees and 50,000 POA in bonds.
